function.name: search_google
function.description: Performs a search query on Google and returns a list of URLs that match the search criteria. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

query.description: The search term to query on Google.

num_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return. The number must be a positive integer.

language.description: The language for the search results.

filter.description: A flag to filter explicit content in search results.

date_range.description: The date range for the search results in the format 'MM/DD/YYYY-MM/DD/YYYY'. If not specified, searches across all dates.

message.content:
Here’s a concise overview of some of the most prominent vaccine manufacturers worldwide, along with a brief note on their flagship products or notable contributions:

| Manufacturer | Headquarters | Key Vaccines / Notable Contributions |
|--------------|--------------|-------------------------------------|
| **Pfizer‑BioNTech** | New York, USA / Mainz, Germany | mRNA‑based COVID‑19 vaccine (Comirnaty), HPV vaccine (Gardasil 9) |
| **Moderna** | Cambridge, USA | mRNA‑based COVID‑19 vaccine (Spikevax), investigational mRNA vaccines for influenza, RSV, etc. |
| **Johnson & Johnson (Janssen)** | New Jersey, USA | Single‑dose adenovirus‑vector COVID‑19 vaccine (Ad26.COV2.S), HPV vaccine (Gardasil 9) |
| **AstraZeneca** | Cambridge, UK | Adenovirus‑vector COVID‑19 vaccine (Vaxzevria), HPV vaccine (Cervarix) |
| **Novavax** | Gaithersburg, USA | Protein‑subunit COVID‑19 vaccine (Nuvaxovid), influenza vaccine (FluBlok) |
| **GlaxoSmithKline (GSK)** | Brentford, UK | HPV vaccine (Gardasil 9), influenza vaccine (Fluzone), pneumococcal conjugate vaccine (Prevnar 13) |
| **Sanofi Pasteur** | Lyon, France | Influenza vaccine (Fluzone), HPV vaccine (Cervarix), meningococcal vaccine (Menveo) |
| **Merck & Co. (MSD)** | Kenilworth, USA | HPV vaccine (Gardasil), influenza vaccine (Fluzone), pneumococcal conjugate vaccine (Prevnar 13) |
| **Bharat Biotech** | Hyderabad, India | Covaxin (COVID‑19 vaccine), hepatitis B vaccine |
| **Sinovac Biotech** | Beijing, China | Inactivated COVID‑19 vaccine (CoronaVac), influenza vaccine |
| **Sinopharm (Hepatitis B Vaccine)** | Beijing, China | Inactivated COVID‑19 vaccine (BBIBP‑CorV), hepatitis B vaccine |
| **CureVac** | Tübingen, Germany | mRNA‑based COVID‑19 vaccine (CVnCoV, still in trials) |
| **Biontech (now part of Pfizer‑BioNTech)** | Mainz, Germany | mRNA‑based COVID‑19 vaccine (Comirnaty) |
| **Novartis** | Basel, Switzerland | Influenza vaccine (Fluzone) |
| **Roche** | Basel, Switzerland | Influenza vaccine (Fluzone) |
| **Boehringer Ingelheim** | Ingelheim am Rhein, Germany | Influenza vaccine (Fluzone) |
| **Eli Lilly** | Indianapolis, USA | Influenza vaccine (Fluzone) |
| **Bayer** | Leverkusen, Germany | Influenza vaccine (Fluzone) |
| **GSK (GlaxoSmithKline)** | Brentford, UK | HPV vaccine (Gardasil 9), influenza vaccine (Fluzone) |
| **Sanofi Pasteur** | Lyon, France | HPV vaccine (Cervarix), influenza vaccine (Fluzone) |
| **Merck & Co. (MSD)** | Kenilworth, USA | HPV vaccine (Gardasil), influenza vaccine (Fluzone) |

### How to Use This List
- **Research**: If you’re looking into vaccine development pipelines, focus on companies with active mRNA or adenovirus‑vector platforms (Pfizer‑BioNTech, Moderna, Janssen, AstraZeneca).
- **Investment**: Companies with diversified portfolios (GSK, Sanofi, Merck) often have more stable revenue streams.
- **Public Health**: For global vaccine distribution, consider manufacturers with large production capacities and established supply chains (Pfizer‑BioNTech, Moderna, Sinovac, Sinopharm).

Let me know if you’d like more detailed information on any specific manufacturer, their clinical trial status, or their geographic reach!
